summary: Phases 16 and 17 both LANDED, green, committed. This dispatch lifted the Phase-15 gate probe into production as purely-additive content in Cslib/Foundations/Relation/Euclidean.lean (the only file touched), beside the existing RightEuclidean API. TASK IS NOT FINISHED: this is 18/24. Phases 18-23 (modalApplyOneFive rule + termination port, 5-soundness, extractModelFive, 5-completeness, KB5, final decidability) remain the genuinely new modal-tableau surface.
